title: Audrey Hepburn's birth chart
metaDescription: Audrey Hepburn's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 13.5° Taurus. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Across the ten placements whose signs are settled, cardinal leads with five. The four cardinal signs sit at the solstices and equinoxes — the scheme’s ignition points, and this chart is weighted to them.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Taurus, but precisely: 13.5°, second decan, 10°–20°, under Mercury in the triplicity scheme. The tradition kept these divisions because thirty degrees is a long street.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 1.0° Gemini; Venus stands at 22.7° Aries; Mars stands at 25.4° Cancer. The tradition reads a mind at home in argument and pattern from Mercury, taste that runs toward the vivid and the immediate from Venus, drive that moves on certainty and current from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than Saturn and Neptune: 1.4° from an exact trine. Trines are read as inheritance rather than achievement: the ease is genuine, and nothing about it was earned. Behind it, Mercury square Neptune at 2.4°, and Venus square Mars at 2.7° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The classical table has four entries for this chart. Mercury in Gemini at 1.0° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Venus in Aries at 22.7° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Mars in Cancer at 25.4° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Saturn in Capricorn at 0.0° is in domicile. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 3 earth, 3 water, 3 fire, 1 air; by modality, 5 cardinal, 3 fixed, 2 mutable. Earth weights a chart toward the material and the durable — what can be built, kept, and relied on. Venus, Saturn and Neptune were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Pisces for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.0° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 11.3°.
